title: Furnish Names Shall Be Respected
description: Use server name instead of mojang names for furnish letters
body:
A Minecraft mod that ensures server-defined names are respected for Furnish letters!

# 📜 Overview
Tired of Mojang’s default naming system overriding your carefully customized server names? Furnish Names Shall Be Respected is a simple yet powerful mod that ensures Furnish letter blocks display server-specific names instead of Mojang’s defaults. Whether you're a server owner, a builder, or a roleplay enthusiast, this mod ensures your names stay exactly as you intend them to be.

# ✨ Features
- Server Name Override – Ensures that the names assigned by the server are used for Furnish letters instead of default Mojang names.
- Supports Multiplayer – Works seamlessly on multiplayer servers, keeping custom names consistent across all players.
- Lightweight & Optimized – Minimal performance impact, designed for smooth gameplay.
- Seamless Integration – Works with existing Furnish letters, requiring no additional configuration.
- Custom Roleplay & Server Branding – Perfect for RPG servers, custom game modes, or personalized builds that rely on specific naming conventions.

# 🌎 Why Use This Mod?
If you run a roleplay server, a custom city build, or just want a clean and consistent naming system, this mod is a must-have! Stop struggling with Mojang’s default behavior and take full control of how your world is named.
